## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 10 сент. 2026 г. - 16 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Geraldine Rolo_, 16 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I had subscribed to a trial period and I immediately canceled the subscription in the playstore to avoid deductions in the future. the app no longer appeared under my subscription list. i received a notification from my bank informing me that this app had deducted money from my account without my consent"
            2. _E D_, 16 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "this app charged me for subscription without giving any notice to give me time to cancel the free trial and know I cannot go to the billing terms in the app. because it says no internet connection eventhough I clearly have internet. this is clearly a scam."
            3. _David Thurlow_, 16 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I gave this app a trial. It wasn't for me so I tried to cancel my subscription. That was nearly a year ago. I have been charged every quarter since. Have tried to remove my card details without success. Beware!!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      6 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 23 мая 2026 г. - 15 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Bonolo Rambau_, 15 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "the app glitches, i can't even access my meal plan. I have been a member for less than an hour"
            2. _Jerick Órdenes_, 11 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "The app freezes on every start and sometimes crashes. It's very annoying for a paid app."
            3. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 мая 2026 г., 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
<!--/ir-theme-->
